dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't our esteemed guest...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Color me impressed! What you did was a feat for the ages.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Perhaps one day, should I ask for your help, I hope that you'll still be willing to offer it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give you a hand when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Then I thank you in advance.
